links.outcome: Fairness of ECG model performance across age and sex subgroups
links.effect: Minimal disparities, with true positive rate and false positive rate differences below 0.010 across age and sex groups.
links.quote: Fairness analyses revealed minimal disparities (true positive rate & false positive rate difference<0.010) across age and sex groups.

links.outcome: AUROC drop from internal to external public and private datasets
links.effect: DeepECG-SSL AUROC 0.990 internal, 0.981 external public, 0.983 external private; DeepECG-SL 0.992, 0.980, 0.983 respectively.
links.quote: DeepECG-SSL achieved AUROCs of 0.990 (95%CI 0.990, 0.990) on internal dataset, 0.981 (95%CI 0.981, 0.981) on external public datasets, and 0.983 (95%CI 0.983, 0.983) on external private datasets, while DeepECG-SL demonstrated AUROCs of 0.992 (95%CI 0.992, 0.992), 0.980 (95%CI 0.980, 0.980) and 0.983 (95%CI 0.983, 0.983) respectively.

unlisted_practices: Self-supervised pretraining versus supervised learning for data-efficient ECG models
Open-sourcing model weights, preprocessing tools, and validation code

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks two ECG foundation models across multiple external datasets and examines fairness across demographic subgroups, but does not test a health care deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
